question: What is the 90-day on-time delivery rate across all of our strategic accounts?

input.purpose: Check account tier values and how many active accounts are in each tier
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE _fivetran_active) AS active_n FROM salesforce.account WHERE NOT is_deleted GROUP BY tier_c ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: See shipment status values and date range
input.sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS n, min(created_at) AS first_created, max(created_at) AS last_created, max(_fivetran_synced) AS last_sync FROM carrier_pg.shipment WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: See event types in shipment events
input.sql: SELECT event_type, count(*) AS n, max(_fivetran_synced) AS last_sync FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check linkage between carrier shipments and SAP deliveries, and the date fields available
input.sql: SELECT s.status, count(*) AS n, count(l.vbeln) AS matched_likp, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.wadat_ist IS NOT NULL AND l.wadat_ist <> '00000000') AS has_actual_gi, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.lfdat IS NOT NULL AND l.lfdat <> '00000000') AS has_promised FROM carrier_pg.shipment s LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY s.status

input.purpose: Look at sample SAP delivery date fields and the customer link to Salesforce
input.sql: SELECT l.vbeln, l.kunnr, l.vstel, l.erdat, l.wadat, l.wadat_ist, l.lfdat, l.zz_carrier_id, a.name_1, a.land_1 FROM sap_s4.likp l LEFT JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 a ON a.kunnr = l.kunnr AND NOT a._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT l._fivetran_deleted ORDER BY l.wadat_ist DESC LIMIT 8

input.purpose: Check the strategic accounts' SAP customer numbers and whether they are active in Salesforce
input.sql: SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c, region_c, billing_country, _fivetran_active, is_deleted FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c = 'Strategic' ORDER BY name

input.purpose: Check whether Salesforce account rows are historical versions and whether Halbrook is duplicated
input.sql: SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c, tier_c, _fivetran_active, _fivetran_start, _fivetran_end, is_deleted, last_modified_date FROM salesforce.account WHERE name ILIKE '%halbrook%' OR id IN (SELECT id FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' GROUP BY id HAVING count(*)>1) ORDER BY name, _fivetran_start

input.purpose: Check tier history for accounts with multiple rows to see if current strategic set differs
input.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_total, count(DISTINCT id) AS accounts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE _fivetran_active) AS active_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE _fivetran_active AND tier_c='Strategic') AS active_strategic FROM salesforce.account

input.purpose: Look at the distribution of delivered-event timing vs SAP requested delivery date over the last 90 days
input.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, min(e.event_at) AS first_ev, max(e.event_at) AS last_ev, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_at::date > l.lfdat::date) AS late_vs_lfdat FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e JOIN carrier_pg.shipment s ON s.shipment_id = e.shipment_id JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number WHERE e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted AND e.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-08 00:00:00+00'

input.purpose: Compare delivered-event timing with SAP requested delivery date (lfdat) and planned goods-issue date (wadat), last 90 days
input.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, min(e.event_at) AS first_ev, max(e.event_at) AS last_ev, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_at::date > try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date) AS late_vs_lfdat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_strptime(l.wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d')::date > try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date) AS gi_after_lfdat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_strptime(l.wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d')::date > try_strptime(l.wadat,'%Y%m%d')::date) AS gi_after_wadat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL) AS no_lfdat FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e JOIN carrier_pg.shipment s ON s.shipment_id = e.shipment_id JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted AND e.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-08 00:00:00+00'

input.purpose: Compute 90-day on-time rate for active Strategic accounts, mapping shipment to SAP customer to Salesforce account
input.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT s.shipment_id, s.delivery_number, l.kunnr, e.event_at, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date AS promised, try_strptime(l.wadat,'%Y%m%d')::date AS plan_gi
  FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e
  JOIN carrier_pg.shipment s ON s.shipment_id = e.shipment_id AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted
  JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted
  WHERE e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted AND e.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-08 00:00:00+00' AND e.event_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-07 00:00:00+00'
), acc AS (
  SELECT sap_customer_number_c, name FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active AND NOT is_deleted
)
SELECT count(*) AS deliveries, count(DISTINCT d.shipment_id) AS shipments,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.event_at::date <= d.promised) AS on_time,
  round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.event_at::date <= d.promised)/count(*),1) AS on_time_pct,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.event_at::date > d.promised) AS late,
  count(DISTINCT a.sap_customer_number_c) AS accounts_with_deliveries
FROM d JOIN acc a ON a.sap_customer_number_c = d.kunnr"

auto_fixed: removed a stray trailing double quote

input.purpose: Sensitivity: on-time vs planned goods-issue date (wadat) and vs goods-issue actual; and check Halbrook GmbH SAP match
input.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT s.shipment_id, l.kunnr, e.event_at::date AS del_date, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date AS promised, try_strptime(l.wadat,'%Y%m%d')::date AS plan_gi, try_strptime(l.wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d')::date AS act_gi
  FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e
  JOIN carrier_pg.shipment s ON s.shipment_id = e.shipment_id AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted
  JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted
  WHERE e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted AND e.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-08 00:00:00+00' AND e.event_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-07 00:00:00+00'
), acc AS (SELECT sap_customer_number_c FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active AND NOT is_deleted)
SELECT
  round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.del_date <= d.plan_gi)/count(*),1) AS pct_vs_planned_gi,
  round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.act_gi <= d.promised)/count(*),1) AS pct_goods_issue_vs_lfdat,
  round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.del_date <= d.promised + 1)/count(*),1) AS pct_one_day_grace,
  count(*) AS n
FROM d JOIN acc a ON a.sap_customer_number_c = d.kunnr;

input.purpose: Check SAP customers named Halbrook and whether any shipments map to the unlinked Salesforce duplicate
input.sql: SELECT k.kunnr, k.name_1, k.land_1, k.ktokd, k._fivetran_deleted, (SELECT count(*) FROM sap_s4.likp l WHERE l.kunnr = k.kunnr AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted) AS deliveries FROM sap_s4.kna_1 k WHERE k.name_1 ILIKE '%halbrook%' OR k.kunnr IN ('0000100001')

answer.answer_summary: Across our 26 active Strategic accounts, 86.8% of deliveries in the 90 days from 8 Aug to 6 Nov 2026 arrived on or before the customer's requested delivery date (551 of 635 deliveries; 84 were late). This is measured against the SAP requested delivery date, so it is a reasonable proxy for the contractual promise but not a confirmed contract term.

metrics_used.name: On-time delivery rate (Strategic, 90-day)
metrics_used.definition: Deliveries with a carrier 'delivered' event dated 8 Aug–6 Nov 2026 whose delivered date is on or before the SAP requested delivery date (likp.lfdat), divided by all such deliveries, for shipments linked to active Strategic accounts (Salesforce tier_c = 'Strategic', is_deleted false, _fivetran_active true) matched on SAP customer number.

lineage: carrier_pg.shipment_event (event_type='delivered') -> carrier_pg.shipment (delivery_number) -> sap_s4.likp (lfdat, kunnr) -> salesforce.account (sap_customer_number_c, tier_c='Strategic') -> on_time_delivery_rate
assumptions: 'Strategic' accounts means Salesforce tier_c = 'Strategic' with the account active (26 accounts). Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH is excluded because it is inactive.
On time means the carrier delivered event date is on or before the SAP requested delivery date (likp.lfdat). Torvane has no separate contractual promise-date field, so this is an assumption.
The 90-day window runs from 8 Aug 2026 to 6 Nov 2026, counted by delivered-event date.

Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH is a duplicate Salesforce record with no SAP number. Its deliveries sit under SAP customer 0000100001, which is already counted once under Halbrook Fluid Systems, so there is no double count.
Each delivered shipment maps to one SAP delivery and one customer; cancelled shipments are excluded.
caveats: Sensitivity: measuring goods issue (actual GI date, wadat_ist) against the requested date gives 97.5%, which measures dispatch timeliness, not customer on-time delivery. Allowing a one-day grace period gives 88.3%.
25 of the 26 active Strategic accounts had deliveries in the window; the one without deliveries is not identified here.
Several _fivetran_synced timestamps are dated 11 Nov 2026, after the 6 Nov as-of date. The event data itself stops at 6 Nov 16:27 UTC, so I treated it as current through the as-of date.
Shipments in transit or label-created at the as-of date are not counted, since they have no delivered event yet.
I did not analyse at-risk accounts, which this question did not ask for.

explanation.title: Missed a customer split across two CRM accounts
explanation.detail: Halbrook Fluid Systems has a look-alike duplicate account ("… GmbH") with no SAP number. Two of its open shipping tickets sit on the duplicate, so the customer looked healthy.
